summary: Tested the caseload forms picker, handover acknowledgement, participant profiles, route order and the Home 'Caseload' quick action. Backend: 18/18 passing after one fix. Frontend: all requested flows pass after one fix. Two bugs found and fixed: (1) CRITICAL frontend: caseload.tsx called router.push for the 'Participant profile' button but never imported router, so tapping it threw a ReferenceError. Added the import from expo-router. (2) HIGH backend: GET /api/caseload changed the cached Jotform row object in place when it added handover read_by_me/acks/waiting. A coordinator's acks/waiting lists then showed up in Support Workers' responses for up to 5 minutes, and concurrent users could get the wrong read_by_me. It now copies the row before adding these fields. No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues found in the reviewed files.

critical.issue: FIXED by T1: the handover dict was the shared _cache row and was changed for each request, so coordinator-only acks/waiting leaked to Support Workers and read_by_me could race between users. Fix: h = p['handover'] = dict(h) before adding the fields (routes/caseload.py ~line 284).

minor.issue: Doesn't check that submission_id is a real handover for that participant. Non-workers can ack any string for any participant name, even one that doesn't exist.
Removes caseload_summaries and caseload_shares but not handover_acks for that participant, so orphaned ack records are left behind.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by T1: router was used but not imported, so tapping the button crashed with a ReferenceError.
Opening an unknown or forbidden participant id stays on the spinner for several seconds. React Query retries 404/403 before showing ErrorState. Set retry: false for 4xx errors.

issues: The header 'Write a case note' button (caseload-new-note) still opens only the Coordinator Case Note form directly, while the per-participant button opens the full Day-to-Day picker. This may confuse users.

action_items: Review T1's fix in routes/caseload.py (copy the handover row before adding per-user fields) and keep it.
Review T1's added `import { router } from "expo-router"` in app/caseload.tsx.
Optional: check in /caseload/handover/ack that submission_id belongs to a handover for that participant.
Optional: delete handover_acks when a participant is removed.
Optional: set react-query retry:false on 4xx for /participants/{id} so the error shows straight away.
routes/caseload.py is about 743 lines (over 700). Split participants/profile/export into their own module.
critical_code_review_comments: Route order is fine: /participants/export and /participants/import-template are declared before /participants/{participant_id} and return xlsx (verified).
caseload_forms: the full Day-to-Day list comes from forms_query(user), and prefilled forms come first because of the sort key (kind, title).
The iter49 test test_worker_forms_day_only_prefilled expected every form to be prefilled. Updated it to check only prefilled ones, since non-prefillable forms are now listed by design.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 iter50 after fix; iter49 20/20 after updating the outdated assertion)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after the router import fix

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ participants and TEST_sub_* handover acks were created and then deleted (0 left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (xdist is enabled by default and the module fixture breaks across workers). The handover test runs in-process (ASGITransport plus fake routes.caseload._cache rows) because Jotform has no real submissions. The handover ack UI (caseload-handover-ack-*) wasn't tested in the browser because no live handover exists; it was code reviewed and the backend was checked in-process.
rca_of_issue: Handover leak: fetch_rows caches row dicts and the caseload endpoint puts the same dicts into p['handover'], then sets h['acks'], h['waiting'] and h['read_by_me'] on them. Reproduced in-process: an admin GET then a worker GET made the worker response include acks/waiting. Fixed by copying the row before changing it.
